agreement.title: Instructor agreement
agreement.confirm: I have read and accept this agreement
agreement.intro: Before your first submission you need to accept the current instructor agreement (version {version}).

ai.notEnabled: AI assistance has not been configured on this server, so AI features are not available. Everything else works as usual.

aiAdmin.title: AI usage
aiAdmin.enabled: AI assistance is enabled on this server.
aiAdmin.reindexHint: Rebuilds the tutor index from the course's published version.

appeal.title: Appeal a moderation decision
appeal.help: Explain why the content should be visible again. Staff will review your appeal and you will be notified of the decision.
appeal.filed: Appeal sent. You will be notified of the decision.
appeal.hiddenBody: It may have been removed or hidden by moderators. If you wrote it, you can appeal the decision.
appeal.pageHelp: If content you wrote was hidden, paste its link (or id) and send an appeal.
appeal.link: Link or id of the content
appeal.linkHint: For example the address of the discussion thread.
appeal.none: You have not filed any appeals.

assist.title: AI assistant (drafts for review)
assist.help: Drafts are generated from what you provide and are never saved automatically. Review every draft before inserting it.
assist.inputHint: Optional for notes and outlines; required for caption cleanup.
assist.inserted: Draft inserted into the study notes. Save to keep it.

bookmarks.title: My bookmarks
bookmarks.label: Bookmark label (optional)
bookmarks.login: Log in to bookmark moments in this lesson.
bookmarks.unavailable: This lesson is no longer available.

bulk.title: Add lessons to {module}
bulk.label: Lesson titles, one per line
bulk.hint: Paste a list; bullets and numbering are removed. Up to 100 lessons.
bulk.tooMany: At most 100 lessons at a time.

checklist.help: Your own pre-submission checklist. It does not replace the automatic checks in the Review tab.

conflict.title: These notes were changed by someone else
conflict.body: Your save was refused because a newer version exists. Compare the versions, then reload the latest one or overwrite it with yours.
conflict.reloaded: Latest version loaded. Your unsaved text was discarded.

consent.title: Analytics cookies
consent.body: With your permission we record anonymous, first-party usage events (course and lesson views, checkout starts) to improve courses. Nothing is tracked until you choose. Necessary cookies are always used.
consent.summary: Allow anonymous usage analytics? Nothing is tracked until you choose.

continue.title: Pick up where you left off
continue.empty: Courses you start will appear here.

dashboard.title: Platform dashboard
dashboard.overdue: Courses overdue for review ({n}, older than {months} months)
dashboard.cacheNote: Figures are cached for up to 5 minutes.

duplicate.courseHelp: Creates a new draft owned by you with the same details, modules, lessons and notes. Packages, questions, assessments, resources and co-instructors are not copied; videos are kept only where you may reuse them.
duplicate.titleHint: Leave empty to let the server name the copy.

errors.editor_scope: Editors can change course content only. Pricing, co-instructors, submission, duplication, translations and analytics are for the course owner and co-instructors.
errors.instructor_suspended: Your instructor account is suspended, so studio changes are blocked.
errors.precondition_failed: These notes were changed by someone else. Reload to see the latest version.
errors.agreement_required: You need to accept the current instructor agreement before submitting.
errors.agreement_version_mismatch: The agreement was updated. Reload and accept the latest version.
errors.ai_not_configured: AI assistant isn't enabled on this server.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.ai_rate_limited: You are sending requests too quickly. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.ai_budget_exhausted: The monthly AI allowance has been used up. It resets at the start of next month.
errors.ai_invalid_output: The AI returned an unusable answer. Please try again.
errors.exam_in_progress: AI help is paused while you have an exam in progress in this course.
errors.not_enrolled: Enrol in this course to use this feature.
errors.content_unavailable: This content is temporarily unavailable following a complaint.
errors.translation_language_taken: That language already has a course in this translation group.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait and try again.
errors.appeal_pending: You already have a pending appeal for this content.
errors.appeal_already_decided: Your appeal for this content has already been decided.
errors.not_hidden: This content is not hidden, so there is nothing to appeal.
errors.complaint_closed: This complaint has already been resolved.
errors.video_not_broken: This video is no longer broken.
errors.not_linked: This video is not used by a live course.

folders.title: Course folders
folders.subtitle: Group your enrolled courses.
folders.deleteBody: Delete the folder “{name}”? Courses stay in your dashboard.

held.title: Lesson temporarily unavailable
held.body: This lesson is unavailable while a complaint about it is reviewed. The rest of the course is still available.

mcq.title: Draft multiple-choice questions
mcq.help: Questions are created as Drafts in the question bank and go through normal review before use.
mcq.rejected: {n} generated questions were rejected by the bank's rules:

ops.title: Operations
ops.noBroken: No broken videos in live courses.

plan.title: Study plan
plan.subtitle: A weekly schedule for the courses you are taking.
plan.noCourses: Enrol in a course first; only courses you take can be planned.
plan.fits: The plan finishes before your target date.
plan.doesNotFit: At this pace the plan finishes after your target date. Add study time or move the target.
plan.deleteBody: Delete your study plan and its schedule?

practice.label: AI-generated, not reviewed
practice.disclaimer: These questions are generated by AI from the course material. They have not been reviewed by the instructor and are not scored or recorded.

preview.note: This is how learners will see the current draft. Answer keys are never included.

report.title: Report content
report.help: Tell us what is wrong with this {target}. Reports are reviewed by the Mastemy trust & safety team.
report.evidenceHint: At least 20 characters ({n} so far). Include links to the original work for copyright reports.
report.evidenceShort: Please give at least 20 characters of detail.
report.emailOptional: Optional: defaults to your account email.
report.name: Your name (optional)
report.thanks: Thank you. Your report was received and will be reviewed.

revisions.title: Notes revisions
revisions.restored: Revision restored as a new revision.
revisions.dirtyWarning: You have unsaved changes. Restoring replaces them.

templates.label: Start from a template (optional)
templates.hint: Adds the template's modules, lessons and checklist to the new draft.

translations.title: Language versions
translations.help: Link courses that teach the same content in another language. Learners see the other languages on the course page once they are published.
translations.unlink: Unlink this course from its group

trust.title: Trust & safety
trust.instructorIdHint: Paste the user id from Users & roles.
trust.suspendHelp: Suspension removes the instructor role, blocks studio changes and holds earnings. Learners keep access to live courses.

tutor.login: Log in to use the AI features.
tutor.intro: The tutor answers only from this course's published material and cites its sources. Your conversations are private.
tutor.empty: Ask a question about this course.
tutor.streamFailed: The answer was interrupted. Please try again.
